description: "Child" means any natural person younger than 13 years of age (§ 59.1-575). Personal data collected from a known child is sensitive data (§ 59.1-575) and must be processed in accordance with the federal Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (15 U.S.C. § 6501 et seq.) (§ 59.1-578(A)(5), (F)(3); § 59.1-576(D)).
